scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && tsx tools/validate-episode.ts
scripts.render: bash tools/log.sh validate tsx tools/validate-episode.ts && bash tools/log.sh render tsx tools/render.ts
scripts.render:shorts: for n in 1 2 3 4; do bash tools/log.sh render-box$n tsx tools/render.ts --id U1E3-BOX$n || exit 1; done
scripts.setup: npm run setup:downloads && tsx tools/ensure-data.ts && npm run build:turns && npm run build:tts && npm run placeholder-audio && npm run build:timing && npm run make:sfx && npm run placeholder-heads && npm run sync:manifest && npm run validate && npm run setup:practice
scripts.package: cd .. && rm -f apush/dist/apush-episode-kit.zip && mkdir -p apush/dist && zip -rq apush/dist/apush-episode-kit.zip apush -x 'apush/node_modules/*' 'apush/out/*' 'apush/dist/*' 'apush/public/*' 'apush/tts/*' '*.DS_Store' 'apush/data/*/turns.json' 'apush/data/*/timing_map.json' 'apush/data/*/levels.json' 'apush/data/*/word_times.json' 'apush/data/images.lock.json' 'apush/script/*-practice.md' 'apush/scene.tsx' 'apush/images.jso' 'apush/# U1-E3*' 'apush/.bundle-check.ts' && ls -lh apush/dist/apush-episode-kit.zip
scripts.setup:practice: tsx tools/build-practice-script.ts --unit u1 && tsx tools/ensure-data.ts --episode u1-practice && tsx tools/build-turns.ts --episode u1-practice && tsx tools/build-tts.ts --episode u1-practice && tsx tools/make-placeholder-audio.ts --episode u1-practice && tsx tools/build-timing.ts --episode u1-practice && tsx tools/sync-manifest.ts --episode u1-practice && bash tools/log.sh validate-practice tsx tools/validate-episode.ts --episode u1-practice
scripts.render:prototype: bash tools/log.sh render-prototype tsx tools/render.ts --id ExchangeCrossing
scripts.motion-check: bash tools/log.sh motion-check tsx tools/motion-check.ts --id exchangecrossing
scripts.render:demos: for id in SectionalismDemo VotesDemo RoadToRevolutionDemo DocumentDemo CharactersDemo CivilWarDemo MarketRevolutionDemo; do bash tools/log.sh render-$id tsx tools/render.ts --id $id || exit 1; done
scripts.render:practice: bash tools/log.sh render-practice tsx tools/render.ts --id U1-PRACTICE
